title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (First Hire)
description:
**Senior Full Stack Engineer** 
 (First Hire)
 



 Hamburg, Germany · Starting part\-time, mid\-June,
 



  





***Overview:***




  





**Who:** 




 First engineering hire at a bootstrapped voice\-to\-insight platform (paying customers, Hamburg\-based)
 



**What:** 




 Senior full\-stack dev (7\+ years) to own data layer, set engineering standards, mentor juniors
 



**Stack:** 




 Next.js, React, TypeScript, Supabase (Postgres \+ RLS), Vercel
 



**Vibe:** 




 Pragmatic craftsmanship, ambitious team, beauty in chaos, growth phase, AI\-assisted pragmatism
 



**You:** 




 Seasoned, calm under pressure, love mentoring, know when to build properly vs. ship fast
 



**Perks:** 




 Direct founder collaboration, real ownership, hybrid/on\-site St. Pauli, flexible hours
 



  





  





***In Detail:***




  





**What we're building** 




 Take\-Aw.ai turns spoken thoughts — at workshops, events, town halls — into structured
 



 insights, automatically.
 



  





 Events and meetings often fail to truly understand what resonated with people. Our system
 



 captures hundreds of voices simultaneously and transforms them into collective insights in
 



 real time. It's a new form of collective intelligence.
 



  





 The product emerged from our own real\-world frustration. Two founders, Hamburg, St.
 



 Pauli–based: one on growth and sales, one on product and code.
 



  





 Founded in 2026, we're bootstrapped, have paying customers, a clear go\-to\-market
 



 strategy, and are in active product–market fit exploration across several other verticals.
 



  





**The role** 




 We are looking for a senior developer with strong software engineering fundamentals and
 



 coding craftsmanship — someone who learned to build before AI agents entered the room.
 



 You would be the first dedicated engineer on the team.
 



  





 Our technical co\-founder combines strong coding skills with holistic product thinking and
 



 an entrepreneurial mindset. While we always strive for conceptual and architectural clarity,
 



 the current phase calls for pragmatism: knowing that sometimes a scrappy hack, shaped
 



 by exploration and customer urgency, is the right choice.
 



  





 Your job is to be the quality anchor where it counts: in the parts that persist, the data layer,
 



 the abstractions that will be built upon, the interfaces that customers touch.
 



 Take\-Aw.ai GmbH \| Hamburg 1You'll start by working closely alongside the founder, joining an ambitious but still part\-time product team led by one of Hamburg's best digital product designers and a rock\-solid
 



 DevOps engineer. Sooner rather than later, additional (junior) developers will join, and
 



 external freelancers may support along the way. A meaningful part of the role will therefore
 



 be thoughtful, patient PR reviews — not gatekeeping, but mentoring.
 



  





  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Own the data layer and core abstractions that the product is built upon
* Shape engineering standards and best practices for the growing team
* Mentor junior developers through thoughtful, patient code reviews
* Balance architectural clarity with pragmatic delivery under customer urgency
* Collaborate directly with the founding team on product and technical decisions



  





  





**Expected outcomes (first 6–12 months)** 



* Establish robust engineering practices and quality standards
* Build and maintain the core platform features that customers depend on
* Set up mentoring and review processes for incoming junior developers
* Help define the technical roadmap as we scale



  





  





**A note on agentic coding** 




 We use Cursor, OpenCode, and Claude. Code gets generated fast — sometimes very fast.
 



 We're looking for someone with a genuine personal practice in AI\-assisted development:
 



 real opinions about where it helps, where it misleads, and what it means for how engineers
 



 work together. We don't have clean answers. We want someone curious about the
 



 questions.
 



  





  





**What you bring** 



* **7\+ years of professional software development** 
 — enough to have made the



 mistakes you no longer make
 


* **You design systems, not just features** 
 — good names, clear boundaries, structure



 that communicates intent
 


* **You have a craftsperson's pride in the work** 
 — not perfectionism, but best practices



 and standards
 


* **You can coordinate small, distributed teams** 
 without needing a title to do it
* **Expertise in Next.js / React** 
 , with a feel for simplicity
* **Solid Postgres experience** 
 , including Row Level Security and realtime features
* **Supabase experience is a genuine plus**



  





  





**Who you are** 




 You're a seasoned craftsperson: quick to understand, steady in chaos.
 



 You've probably worked at a startup before and know that "founder mode" is real.
 



 You don't take it personally.
 



 You find satisfaction in quiet, durable quality — not in authority.
 



 You're comfortable saying "this part should be done properly" and also "this part can wait."
 



 That judgment is exactly what we need.
 



  





**Non\-functional expectations** 



* You're calm and effective in ambiguity
* You have a tolerance for "founder mode" and don't take it personally
* You find satisfaction in building things that last, not in having authority



  





  





**What we offer** 



* Direct collaboration with the founding team
* Best\-in\-class teammates in a growing environment
* Real ownership over engineering quality from day one
* A product people actually use, in a domain (voice → insight) that's only getting more



 relevant
 


* Flexible or fixed working hours, depending on your preferences
* Hybrid or on\-site work from our office in Hamburg St. Pauli
* Additional benefits and support packages by agreement



  





  





**Application** 




 Send your application to
 **jobs@take\-aw.ai** 




 We will keep this open until the end of May 2026
 



 and will then start to review all applications.
 



  





  





**Appendix: Tech Stack** 




  





**Languages \& Runtime** 




 TypeScript (frontend \& backend)
 



 Node.js
 



  





**Frontend** 




 Next.js (App Router, React Server Components)
 



 React 18
 



 Tailwind CSS and BEM\-style CSS Modules
 



  





**Backend \& Data** 




 Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions)
 



 Row Level Security (RLS) as primary authorization mechanism
 



 JWT\-based multi\-tenancy
 



  





**Testing \& Quality** 




 Vitest for unit/integration tests
 



 Playwright for E2E tests
 



 ESLint (\+ typescript\-eslint)
 



  





**Infrastructure \& Tooling** 




 GitHub
 



 Vercel for Next.js hosting
 



 Supabase Cloud for production DB \& Edge Functions
